feature: Edit each moment/feed photograph before publishing and reuse its editable artwork in an album.

behavior.reuse: Editable layers, font styles, framing, crop, rotation and artboard clipping transfer proportionally to newly created or appended album pages.
behavior.caption: The separate record/feed caption remains below the photo and is not automatically placed into new album pages.
behavior.existingData: Existing saved album pages, captions, original photo objects and current album edit sessions are preserved.
behavior.drafts: Photo artwork persists through local drafts and retries; browser recovery indexes retain compact summaries while full draft records retain artwork.

newCoverage: Original pixels and separate captions survive repeated decoration
Cancel and account changes preserve the correct draft
Existing album draft and undo history remain isolated
Saved photo design metadata round trips
Bounded private metadata and material entitlements
Raster-only public feed and correct artwork ratio
New album and append exclude feed captions
Clip geometry survives save, resize, cover spine and print
Off-artboard content remains hidden across different album ratios

limitations: The client changes require a subsequent app build/release before appearing in the distributed app.
The editor currently uses eight free sticker styles and existing gated frames; it does not expose the entire paid sticker catalog.
